outcome: No result advancing or resolving Kueker's conjecture (that a countable theory all of whose uncountable models are ω-saturated must be categorical in some infinite power) was found dated after 26 January 2024; the known partial results (stable theories: Hrushovski 1989; superstable theories: Buechler 1984; theories interpreting a linear order or with Skolem functions) remain the state of the art, and the general conjecture, including the case of simple theories, is still open.
summary: Kueker's conjecture asks whether a countable first-order theory all of whose uncountable models are ω-saturated must be categorical in some infinite power. All resolved special cases pre-date the frozen revision by decades: Buechler (1984) for superstable theories, Hrushovski (1989) for stable theories (and for theories interpreting a linear order or with Skolem functions), and Tanović's 2012 work 'On Kueker's Conjecture' addressing further cases including aspects of simple theories via 'Kueker simple' theories. I ran targeted searches for post-January-2024 activity — arXiv listings, Google-style web search for the conjecture's name combined with 'simple theories', '2024', '2025', '2026', 'omega-categorical', 'omega-stable', and 'AI'/'theorem prover' — and found nothing new. One search result surfaced an arXiv paper 'Remarks on relative categoricity' (arXiv 2602.05866, Shelah–Usvyatsov lineage, submitted 2026-02-05) that a search-engine summary associated with Kueker's conjecture; I opened the paper directly and it does not mention Kueker's conjecture at all — it concerns a different notion, 'relative categoricity' and the Gaifman conjecture over a predicate, and the association was a false positive from the search summarizer, not a real connection. I also checked 'Simple Homogeneous Structures and Indiscernible Sequence Invariants' (arXiv 2405.08211, May 2024), which appeared in results for 'Kueker's conjecture simple theories' but on direct inspection does not reference Kueker's conjecture either. No arXiv preprint, journal paper, blog digestion (Tao, Quanta, etc.), or Lean/Coq repository addressing this specific conjecture was found in the window. This matches and confirms the triage's 'none' verdict; my independent searches, including checking the two false-positive leads by opening the primary sources directly, did not surface anything the triage missed.
competing_reading: None found. The only ambiguity was whether the two arXiv papers turned up by search (2602.05866 and 2405.08211) bore on this conjecture; direct inspection of both ruled that out, so there is no live competing reading of the evidence.
what_would_settle_it: A preprint or paper explicitly invoking 'Kueker's conjecture' by name (or its precise statement: uncountable ω-saturation implying categoricity) for simple theories or an unrestricted general case, dated after 26 January 2024; none exists as far as I could determine.
